chunks: And it is narrated from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, that he said:

"Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, and His angels send blessings upon those who seek forgiveness and those who partake in suhoor in the pre-dawn hours. So let one of you partake in suhoor, even if only with a drink of water."

key_terms.الْمُتَسَحِّرِينَ: those who partake in suhoor before dawn

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of suhoor and seeking forgiveness before dawn in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages both seeking forgiveness and taking suhoor in the pre-dawn time, presenting both as acts graced by divine and angelic blessings. It highlights the spiritual value of the pre-dawn hours and recommends that suhoor should not be abandoned, even if it is only a sip of water.
